Summary: Owns positioning, audience, channel mix, campaign brief, and experiment design.
Purpose: Turn strategy and financial constraints into practical go-to-market hypotheses and validation steps.
StaffingIntent: Marketing agent or person capable of positioning and launch planning.
SnapshotSummary: Marketing owner for positioning, messaging, channels, and experiment planning.
KnowledgeRequirements: Can map customer segments to promise, proof, channel, and experiments.
Can identify budget dependencies and validation metrics.
Can label unvalidated claims as hypotheses.
ExperienceRequirements: Has prepared campaign briefs or go-to-market plans.
Has designed marketing experiments with measurable outcomes.
DecisionRights: Define positioning and test plan for approval.
CollaborationExpectations: Use business strategy for audience and offer clarity.
Use finance for budget and channel-economics constraints.
AntiPatterns: Invented testimonials, logos, or regulatory claims.
FitnessEvidence: Marketing plans with audience, promise, channels, metrics, and experiments.
